title: 常用的电子产品
cue:
Describe something that you use often.
You should say：
what it is
what it is like
what you use it for
and explain why you like it.
a:
I'm going to talk about my iPad Air. It was a birthday present from my parents.

It's very thin and light. I can easily carry it with just one hand. I guess that's why it's called iPad “Air”.

The chip of my iPad is very fast and all the apps and games run smoothly without lagging. The screen looks sharp and clear and the colours are bright and vivid. The image quality of the iSight camera is excellent. It can record HD videos as well.

The battery life is quite good, too. I can spend a whole afternoon on my iPad and still don't need to recharge the battery.

I use my iPad to send and receive emails, watch films, listen to music and play games. Also, I often use it to take pictures and record videos.

I like my iPad because it looks great and has many user-friendly features. I like it also because it reminds me of my parents' love for me.
vocab: （应用程序和游戏）运行流畅，没有滞后
（屏幕的显示效果）锐利清晰的
电池充一次电之后能够使用的时间（不要只看字面意思误解成电池的终生寿命）
方便使用的，“用户友好的”
有很多方便使用的特色功能
unlock my phone with Face ID
browse the Web / surf the Internet
（相机）捕捉人生里的特殊瞬间
重要事务列表应用程序
fitness band 或者 fitness tracker

title: 照片之 与人合影
cue:
Describe a photo that you like.
You should say：
when it was taken
where it was taken
how it was taken
and explain why you like it.
a:
照片是平面的（two-dimensional），甚至放大之后也就只有那么大，如果只能从照片的一个 corner 描述到另一个 corner 说两分钟是比较困难的，但适当谈谈拍照的经过和自己的感受却可以让你轻松地说够考官期待的时间。

比如：旅游时偶遇名人拍的一张合影，春节时全家人一起拍的一张照片，和父母一起度假时在一个旅游景点拍的一张照片，参加一个朋友的婚礼时与新娘（bride）和新郎（groom）一起拍的一张照片，参加某个考试拿到成绩之后的一张自拍（selfie）等，都可以自然地谈出一些照片之外的内容。

Pat 的答案

I'm going to talk about a photo that I like. It was taken last month while I was at the Hong Kong airport waiting for my flight.

I was chatting with some friends. All of a sudden, I noticed a man who looked exactly like … （the celebrity's name）.

… is… （这里可以自然地加入 2~3 句介绍这个 celebrity 的内容，但是不要长，注意这部分可以用一般现在时）

I became really curious. So I went up to him and asked if he was… He smiled politely and nodded. I was so excited because I'd never thought I could meet him in person.

I told him I really liked his films（或者 songs, music videos, TV shows）. Also, I took out my mobile phone and asked him if I could take a selfie with him.

He was like, “Sure!” And he smiled and posed for the picture. He even said “cheese”!

Once I returned home, I printed out the picture and hung it on my bedroom wall, and I've shown it to many friends.

I like the picture because it reminds me of a very exciting experience. I'd never thought such a famous person could be so friendly and approachable.
vocab: 在真实生活里遇到某人
他 / 她当时说：“……”（口语里经常这样引述别人的话）
说“茄子”（中文照相时说“茄子”，而英文照相时说 cheese“奶酪”）
（某个人或某个事物）让我一整天都很开心

title: 手工制作
cue:
